en: Black-and-white view of a modernist European town square with a tall clock‑ or bell‑tower on the left bearing a large statue at its base, a curved corner apartment block with balconies on the right, and mountains with snow in the background. Pedestrians, bicycles, and early-to-mid 20th‑century cars are visible. At the street corner there is a direction signpost with several Italian place names.
